payload.title: Constrained editorial revision pass
payload.description:
**Phase 3 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d`.

## Done when

- One revision pass takes source draft + style profile + diagnosis JSON.
- Prompt is senior copy editor, not “humanizer”: preserve meaning; no invented anecdotes/stats/citations/first-person; revise only diagnosed problems; prefer deletion; style guide over generic Internet prose.
- Returns revised_text, change_log (reason + whether fact verification required), unresolved_questions.
- Banned detector-evasion tactics (fake typos, slang spam, manufactured imperfections) are explicitly forbidden in the skill/prompt.

## Depends on

Style profile store; diagnostic JSON pass.
